title: Estimation of walking energy expenditure using a single sacrum-mounted IMU based on biomechanically-informed machine learning
summary: Methods develop a single sacrum-mounted IMU estimator using biomechanical features; Results analyze walking energy expenditure and joint-power contributions in 13 participants. The reported measurements support the bounded estimation result.
ai_technology: Walking energy-expenditure estimates were validated against measured biomechanics in 13 participants. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
